body:
## updates

* sbtn on x86-64 Linux is statically linked to musl, take 2 by @francisdb in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10070
* deps: Update Coursier to 2.1.27 by @eed3si9n in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10090

## 🐛 bug fixes
* fix: Honor `csrMavenDependencyOverride` by @anatoliykmetyuk in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10074
* fix: Send Content-Length on HTTP/2 uploads @eugkhp in https://github.com/eed3si9n/gigahorse/pull/132
* fix: Eliminate final-field mutation warnings in forked tests by @anatoliykmetyuk in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10080
* fix: Fix packageInternal failing during concurrent copyResources by @seveneves in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10091
* fix: Invalidate cached tests on external classpath changes by @anatoliykmetyuk in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10093
* fix: Fix build load failing on a symlink loop under the base directory by @ghostbuster91 in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10082
* fix: Fix publish to sftp and ssh resolvers by @eed3si9n in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10095 + https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10099
* fix: Fix history permission warning after upgrade by @anatoliykmetyuk in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10101

## behind the scenes

* docs: Update release notes by @eed3si9n in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10072
* ci: Update sbt and plugins by @xuwei-k in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10071
* deps: Bump GraalVM to 25 by @eed3si9n in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10073
* ci: Add GitHub Actions lockfile by @xuwei-k in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10083
* ci: Use windows-2022 for sbtn-test by @eed3si9n in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10088
* Discard tasty files in lmcoursier by @xuwei-k in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10079
* ci: Add `timeout-minutes` settings to all GitHub Actions by @xuwei-k in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10087
* build(deps): bump eed3si9n/scruff from 0.3.3 to 0.4.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10081
* Update Gigahorse to 0.9.8 by @eed3si9n in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10089
* ci: Remove unnecessary `ConflictWarning.disable` setting by @xuwei-k in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10096
* Update sbtn to 2.1.1 by @eed3si9n in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10100

## new contributors
* @francisdb made their first contribution in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/10070

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sbt/sbt/compare/v2.1.0...v2.1.1
